verdict.rationale: Mercury's own docs say it issues scoped API tokens with fine-grained permissions and offers three token types: read-only, read-write, and custom. Access can be revoked at any time from the dashboard, which covers least-privilege credentials an agent could use. Missing for 10: documentation of exactly which scopes or endpoints a custom token can be limited to, evidence of agent- or MCP-specific credential scoping, and independent or hands-on confirmation that scoping works as claimed.
